## Learning Objective

- Explain calibration in logistic regression.
- Interpret a calibration plot.


## Lesson

```{r}
library(caret)
d <- Lock5Data::NutritionStudy
d$SmokeYes <- ifelse(test = d$Smoke == "Yes",
                     yes = 1,
                     no = 0)
d$YearsSince40 <- d$Age - 40
mod_01 <- glm(formula = SmokeYes ~ YearsSince40 + VitaminUse + Sex,
              family = binomial,
              data = d)
cal_obj <- calibration(x = as.factor(d$SmokeYes) ~ mod_01$fitted.values,
                       class = "1")
plot(cal_obj)

library(probably)
cal_plot_breaks(.data = data.frame(truth = as.factor(mod_01$model$SmokeYes),
                                   estimate = mod_01$fitted.values),
                truth = truth,
                estimate = estimate,
                event_level = "second")
```
